qualification.education_qualification: Qualifications vary by post, including medical degrees, diplomas, and general education. Minimum 12th-pass.
qualification.details: Gynecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned / DNB. Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Medical Qualification. Minimum 03 years experience in the specialty after Post Graduation. Radiologist: A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second schedule of Part II of the third schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956. Post Graduate degree in the concerned Specialty mentioned in section A or section B of schedule VI of Central Health service Regulations 1996. Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hyg/ Class 1 DH / DORA Course (Armed Forces). Minimum 05 years experience in the specialty. Chowkidar: Class VIII or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel. Minimum 05 yrs experience in dental lab.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 9 vacancies are available - 1 for Gynecologist, 1 for Medical Specialist (Gen Med), 1 for Radiologist, 1 for Dental Hygienist and 3 for Chowkidar.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Gynecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned / DNB. Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Medical Qualification. Minimum 03 years experience in the specialty after Post Graduation. Radiologist: A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second schedule of Part II of the third schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956. Post Graduate degree in the concerned Specialty mentioned in section A or section B of schedule VI of Central Health service Regulations 1996. Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hyg/ Class 1 DH / DORA Course (Armed Forces). Minimum 05 years experience in the specialty. Chowkidar: Class VIII or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel. Minimum 05 yrs experience in dental lab.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Gynecologist: Maximum age 68 years. Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Maximum age 68 years. Radiologist: Maximum age 68 years. Dental Hygienist: Maximum age 56 years. Chowkidar: Maximum age 53 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS Thiruvananthapuram recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS Thiruvananthapuram recruitment is 07 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Contractual Staff posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for Contractual Staff posts announced by ECHS Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Chowkidar post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Chowkidar post is Class VIII or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel, along with a minimum of 05 years of experience in a dental lab.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Medical Specialist post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Specialist (Full Time) post is Rs 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Dental Hygienist post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Dental Hygienist post is 56 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes a written test and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, which is echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to Station Headquarters (ECHS), Pangode, Thirumala - PO, Thiruvananthapuram-695 006.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
